desc:
Cars have deformation or softbody physics although its not perfect and might be laggy for some devices 

To enter multiplayer press the Menu button on the right of your screen and at the button Press Mutliplayer and join a server,
Note that the car crashes may be desynced due to lag 

Controls---
the Car crashes may not be realistic
C -- Shows the colliders of the car
T -- changes traction control
P -- Freezes the current car
V -- Parking brake
U -- hides ui
B -- changes camera point of view
J -- settings for the car deformation(After reset)
M -- Changes gravity
